tool.name: Merge Water Residues
tool.description: Extract specific water residues from a PDB file and merge into a System PDB file

param.name: water_pdb
param.label: PDB with water molecules
param.help: Input PDB file containing water residues to extract

param.name: system_pdb
param.label: System PDB file
param.help: Target System PDB file to append water molecules into

param.name: residue_numbers
param.label: Residue numbers (space-separated)
param.help: Space-separated list of residue numbers to extract (e.g. 293 309 310)

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool extracts specific water residues (or other residues) from a source PDB file and appends them to a target System PDB file.
**Inputs**
- **PDB with water molecules**: Source PDB file containing the water residues you want to extract - **System PDB file**: Target System PDB file where the extracted residues will be appended - **Residue numbers**: Space-separated list of residue numbers to extract (e.g., 293 309 310) - **Residue name**: Name of residue type to match (HOH, WAT, SPC, TIP3P, LIG, or ALL)
**Output**
- **Merged PDB**: Combined PDB file containing:
- All atoms from the original System PDB - Extracted residues from the source PDB - HOH residues automatically converted to WAT - Proper TIP3 element column formatting - TER records between residues for structure termination - END record at the end of file
**Features**
- Automatically converts HOH to WAT naming conventions - Adds proper element column (TIP3) for water molecules - Inserts TER records between residues - Appends to System PDB before the END record - Preserves original atom and residue numbering
**Example Workflow**
To extract residues 293 and 309 (HOH type) from water.pdb and merge into system.pdb:
- Water PDB: water.pdb - System PDB: system.pdb - Residue numbers: 293 309 - Residue name: HOH
